title: allium angulosum subsp. ammophilum
intro: Allium angulosum subsp. ammophilum, commonly known as Wild Onion or Rock Garlic, is a perennial plant species in the Allium genus. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, thanks to its health benefits, which include antibacterial, antiviral, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it effective in reducing fever, relieving respiratory issues, and addressing gastrointestinal problems. The therapeutic actions of Wild Onion involve its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve flatulence, and ease respiratory congestion. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sulfur compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
